text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand, which helps both themselves and their teammates. Good refactoring also reduces technical debt, the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly and messy. By cleaning up the code, teams can fix bugs more easily and add new features faster in the future. Remember, the key rule of refactoring is simple: the program should behave exactly the same before and after.
